name: catalyst-ops
description: How Catalyst Shift operates (the Claude dev factory, catalyst-brain strategy/2026-10-23-claude-dev-factory.md). Four skills: card (write a card the factory can build), next (build one card by hand — the named card or the top Ready For Factory card → In Progress → branch from fresh origin/main → gstack (/investigate, /review, /cso on deep paths, /qa on the preview) → /ship opens a PR that carries the evidence → a fresh session (not the builder) runs /review (+ /cso on deep paths) and writes the Reviewed: <head sha> stamp that the review stamp CI check enforces; never auto-merges or merges, Blocked on hard stops; the factory's dispatcher does normal pickup), ways-of-working (three homes + the build method: card-as-spec, the Ready For Factory dispatcher, gstack, people merge by stage, review by risk, recommend-ask-proceed with hard stops), and decision-governance (proposed-vs-decided labelling, ratification rules). Behavior only; canon content stays in the strategy doc and the canon note.
